item: R702 rebuild at the current storage settings (Maintenance action, main library)
summary: Settings > Advanced > Safety > Database maintenance rebuilds an older main library at 16 KiB cipher pages and incremental auto_vacuum: sqlcipher_export into a file declared at the new settings, a copy check (settings, quick_check, schema, row counts), then the restore's swap window. The old file is kept as <stem>.pre-rebuild-<stamp> until the operator removes it from the panel; the free-space preflight counts it. Refused before any copy without a backup answer, with nothing to change, without room, or while any other job, import, restore, folder or volume backup runs. A stop or a save during the copy leaves the library as it was. Panic wipe and data-folder scope know both new names. Lane stores are a later PR.
